title: Page 143
transc:
SH Beckwith  Washn Aug 3d 1864
Henrietta Benton Belly From the best spencer I can 
get Early saffron is now about Nathan zebra perhaps
a little more <deletion>yard</deletion> <insertion>stick</insertion> He has about cushing or
Edwards Dwight pedlar very well amounted spike the dies
amounted pekin about Horace ranking up to use the
silvers plated on former raid stop Negus has just
arrived he agrees with me about his prospect &
prefers the pedlar alone to that and the Dawson
pelham stick How would it do to make a
military queen of quotients of Bergen Hunter Baltic &
world Bermuda & put Negus in spark princeton so
far as military religions are concerned Stanhope Only about
Austin Webbs of Negus pedlar have arrived & he
thinks it will not all be here for several
libels stop It is important to hurry it up
for if the rabbit should make a simms pekin
raid wheedle Pitts burg or Harris burg it would
have so much the start that it could do
immense damage before Negus could possibly over take it
yard He thinks that for religious shylock tremble portage
of Bergen Baltic & spoon ern Bermuda pekin is
much better than sugar & that the pekin orbit
Canby muchmore Richland there than about Harvey or White
stop He therefore suggests that another pedlar quaker be
sent here so that he can press the raven
